headline: US Solar Power Reaches Historic Milestone: Enough to Power 50 Million Homes
meta_description: US solar capacity now powers over one third of all households. The country added 11.4 GW in Q2 2026, up 45% year-over-year.
summary_short: US solar energy can now generate enough clean electricity to power more than 50 million homes—over one third of all American households.
body:
US solar energy can now generate enough clean electricity to power more than 50 million homes—over one third of all American households.

The acceleration is striking. In the second quarter of 2026, the country added 11.4 gigawatts of solar capacity, a 45% increase from the same period a year earlier. This surge reflects growing investment in renewable energy infrastructure and falling solar technology costs that have made clean power increasingly competitive with traditional sources.

The milestone signals a fundamental shift in how America generates electricity. What was once a niche sector has become a meaningful part of the national grid, powering homes across the country and reducing reliance on fossil fuels. As solar continues to scale, these numbers will likely only grow.
quick_facts: US solar now powers 50 million+ homes nationwide

Q2 2026 added 11.4 GW of solar capacity
